# LiquidAI/d1-2B

The slip screen can load `LiquidAI/d1-2B` on this machine. The weights are not in this repository.

The model repo had no `NOTICE` file on 2026-11-01. If Liquid AI ships a NOTICE file later, copy it beside this licence before redistributing the weights.

The model card documents Transformers `trust_remote_code=True`, version 5.19 or later. This screen sends text only. It does not send a slip image.
